exposure: mechanical ventilation with or without surfactant
nasal continuous positive airway pressure with surfactant
cohort: 252 preterm very low birth weight infants and their mothers at a tertiary hospital in Limpopo Province, South Africa
finding: The survival rate of preterm very low birth weight infants was 77.4%, with use of antenatal corticosteroids, spontaneous preterm labour, birthweight, gestational age, Apgar score, resuscitation in delivery room, length of stay, prematurity-related problems, sepsis, pulmonary haemorrhage, hypothermia, jaundice, and respiratory support being significantly associated with infant outcomes.
